title: Yes Domina Training Loop (Standard)
description: This file is a very effective brainwashing loop with a lovely progression. One that loops slowly and methodically, hitting you over and over to view My voice as your own thoughts. My words as your own thoughts. My commands are simply your own thoughts. You want to please Domina. You like to please Domina... Instructions I want you to do a challenge for me though. I want you to pick a nice long article, or be playing a game when you listen to it for your first time. Just have your mind focus on something while you play the whole thing through. And then afterwards see if you can remember anything about what you just read or played. =D And then tell me about it!
author: Mistress Shibby
